canonical_statement: The early stages of human development are characterized by a unified, singular physical and spiritual nature before the onset of differentiation.

attributions.surface_quote: The first seven human shoots were all of one complexion.

canonical_statement: Humanity's evolutionary trajectory involves a shift from a predominantly metaphysical existence to a more material or anthropomorphic state.

attributions.surface_quote: Up to this point of evolution man belongs more to meta.

canonical_statement: The current human species originated with the Fourth Root Race, the Atlanteans.

attributions.surface_quote: it is only from the time of the Atlantean... that one ought to speak of man

attributions.surface_quote: names of the Asuras... passed them on to posterity as the names of fiends

canonical_statement: Spiritual evolution involves the incarnation of divine entities into specific human lineages.

attributions.surface_quote: the Suras, Gods or Devas, having incarnated in the wise men of Atlantis

canonical_statement: The incarnation of divine monads into human form is governed by a karmic law of evolution.

attributions.surface_quote: some obeyed the Law of Evolution immediately the men of the Third Race became ready

canonical_statement: The 'Fall' refers to the delayed incarnation of divine beings who prioritized intellectual freedom over evolutionary duty.

attributions.surface_quote: Those who, jealous of their intellectual freedom... said: 'We can choose' and so incarnated far later

attributions.surface_quote: They got bodies inferior to their Astral Models because their Chhayas had belonged to Progenitors

canonical_statement: Humanity's initial state was one of irresponsibility, meaning the 'fall of man' is a theological misinterpretation.

attributions.surface_quote: The fall of man was no fall, for he was irresponsible.

attributions.surface_quote: the power of Kriyashakti had to be regarded as Satanic

canonical_statement: The 'Fall of the Angels' is an allegorical representation of an anthropological and evolutionary process.

attributions.surface_quote: The true meaning of the old doctrine of the 'Fallen Angels,' in its anthropological and evolutionary sense

canonical_statement: Sacred texts like the Book of Enoch function as manuals for initiation into archaic mysteries.

attributions.surface_quote: Simply a Book of Initiation, giving out in allegory... the programme of certain Archaic Mysteries

canonical_statement: Humanity shares a common evolutionary descent from the beings referred to as 'Fallen Angels' or 'Nephilim'.

attributions.surface_quote: our Secret Doctrine endeavours to show [humanity's] descent from them also

canonical_statement: Theological concepts of God and the Devil are anthropomorphic projections created in the image of humanity.

attributions.surface_quote: Why do you make of your God a Devil— both, moreover, created in your own image?

attributions.surface_quote: Wisdom... descended from on high to animate and call the Third Race to real conscious life.

canonical_statement: The entities identified as fallen spirits or serpents represent the incarnation of divine intelligence into material generation.

attributions.surface_quote: The Angels fallen into generation are referred to metaphorically as Serpents and Dragons of Wisdom.

canonical_statement: The Logos functions as both the embodiment of divine Wisdom and the adversary of ignorance.

attributions.surface_quote: the Logos — who is Wisdom, but at the same time, as the opponent of ignorance, Satan or Lucifer.

canonical_statement: Humanity in its primitive state is characterized by a lack of self-conscious awareness, rendering it subject to moral and physical dissolution.

attributions.surface_quote: Humanity, if it can be so called in its animal, senseless state, was of course doomed.

attributions.surface_quote: Higher Self — formed of the indissoluble union of Buddhi... and the spiritual efflorescence of Manas.

canonical_statement: Buddhi is a passive, latent principle that requires union with self-consciousness to become the Divine Soul.

attributions.surface_quote: Buddhi... is a passive and latent principle... only in union... does Buddhi become the Higher Self.

canonical_statement: The incarnation of the Divine Ray into generation is a descent of spiritual intelligence into material existence.

attributions.surface_quote: reference to the incarnation of the Divine Ray... which falls into generation.

attributions.surface_quote: Initiates alone... knew that it referred to Spirit and Soul on the Earth.

canonical_statement: The Logos functions as passive Wisdom in the celestial realm and active Wisdom in the terrestrial realm.

attributions.surface_quote: The Logos is passive Wisdom in Heaven and conscious, self-active Wisdom on Earth.

canonical_statement: The process of incarnation is governed by an eternal cyclic law of rebirths across cosmic periods.

attributions.surface_quote: There is an Eternal Cyclic Law of Re-births.

canonical_statement: High spiritual entities or 'Gods' descend into material existence to complete the development of Divine Man.

attributions.surface_quote: The Gods who had fallen into generation, whose mission it was to complete Divine Man.

attributions.surface_quote: Flames born of the Universal Mind had landed on this Earth, after breaking through seven intermediate Worlds.

attributions.surface_quote: The Rakshasas are not Demons, but simply the primitive and ferocious Giants.

canonical_statement: The manifestation of time and limitation is a necessary consequence of the emergence of the finite from the infinite.

attributions.surface_quote: Eternity brought forth Time; the Boundless gave birth to Limit.

canonical_statement: The descent of pure being into generation is the foundational process of material existence.

attributions.surface_quote: Being descended into generation.

canonical_statement: A specific entity or force is tasked with governing the outermost sphere of reality and the processes of temporal change.

attributions.surface_quote: God gave him the dominion of the outermost sphere.

attributions.surface_quote: failures are too far progressed... and remain as a latent or inactive spiritual force

attributions.surface_quote: they become an active force and commingle with the elementals, to develop... Self-conscious Mind

attributions.surface_quote: no man may enter therein save the anointed, having the arcanum of Hermes.

attributions.surface_quote: primeval manifestations of the Ever-unmanifested Principle

attributions.surface_quote: Divine Desire in the Gods, as well as in all Nature, to create and give life.

canonical_statement: The entity identified as the Adversary functions as the agent of cosmic justice and karmic regulation.

attributions.surface_quote: Satan is the magistrate of the Justice of God [Karma]

attributions.surface_quote: to him are committed Weight and Measure and Number.

attributions.surface_quote: The Adversary, because Matter opposeth Spirit, and Time accuseth even the saints.

canonical_statement: Satan functions as the divine minister presiding over the manifest physical world.

attributions.surface_quote: Hades, or the Limbo of Illusion... is simply our Globe, the Earth.

attributions.surface_quote: For he is one with the Logos.

attributions.surface_quote: These three die, while the innermost Man is immortal.

attributions.surface_quote: He hath lost his virginal estate... he hath entered into bondage.

attributions.surface_quote: those alone can tell who read the decrees of Fate in the Astral Light

attributions.surface_quote: Without phosphorus no thought.

attributions.surface_quote: CONSCIOUS ENTITY
